name: Electricity and gas market regulation
what: Hold the authorisations or licences needed to generate, transmit, distribute or retail energy and meet national market rules and state-specific obligations.

layers.who: Australian Energy Regulator (retailer authorisation, network revenue)
State energy regulator (licences outside or alongside the national framework)
State energy department (jurisdictional derogations, price settings)

consistency_note: National laws for the eastern and southern states; Western Australia and the Northern Territory run their own systems, and the Harper review found the national retail law applied with major derogations in Victoria and Queensland.

basis.source: Competition Policy Review: Final Report (Harper review)
basis.quote: application of the National Energy Retail Law with minimal derogation by all National Electricity Market jurisdictions

basis.source: Competition Policy Review: Final Report (Harper review)
basis.quote: The Panel supports moves to include Western Australia and the Northern Territory in the National Electricity Market

basis.source: Competition Policy Review: Final Report (Harper review)
basis.quote: In Victoria and Queensland, the National Energy Retail Law has yet to be applied without major derogations
